headline: Real Madrid expected to bid for Rodri; Barcola fee unresolved
paragraphs: The best-corroborated story remains Real Madrid's pursuit of Manchester City's Rodri. BBC's gossip column had City bracing for a bid on July 28, then called Madrid confident of a deal on July 29. Sky Sports, reporting separately, said on July 30 that Madrid are expected to make an offer, a day after a separate Sky piece examined how City would cope without him. Two independent newsrooms agree on the direction, but nothing is confirmed and City have not commented.

Liverpool's move for Paris Saint-Germain forward Bradley Barcola is reported, not closed. BBC's gossip column said on July 29 that Barcola had verbally agreed to join Liverpool, with the clubs still apart on valuation — two days after the same column reported PSG wanting £145m for him. A separate Sky Sports piece named Arsenal as a rival suitor. No fee is agreed and neither club has confirmed a transfer.

Arsenal's interest in Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr shows conflicting signals. The same July 29 BBC item that carried the Barcola news said Real Madrid have no plans to sell the winger, a claim sitting awkwardly next to an earlier BBC report on July 25 that Arsenal were exploring a move, and a July 30 Sky Sports column by Paul Merson describing Arsenal's pursuit as ongoing. The feed does not settle which read is current.
